narrative.details: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Elixir of Wisdom, along with information about delivery location and payment.  At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
narrative.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
narrative.offerRewardText: I will admit, I expected the treacherous winds of the highlands to tear that letter to shreds. I had not imagined that someone would see my humble request, let alone deliver it straight to me.Your efforts are kind and admirable, friend. I will use this to aid my meditation.Feel free to stay and share a tale or two of your travels. I enjoy the company.
narrative.requestItemsText: Come, warm yourself by the fire.

giverName: an item: Craftsman's Writ: Elixir of Wisdom
startItemText: an item: Craftsman's Writ: Elixir of Wisdom
